SLIDE TYPE — LATIN × 日本語

Today the playbook prose renders Latin in pixel DotGothic16 (Latin-only face) and Japanese in smooth Noto Sans JP. Mixed lines like 「GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) は…」 switch style mid-sentence, and the pixel Latin is harder to read at slide size.

Each card renders the same specimen (GHAS H2, body, hero-quote, the GitHub Actions bullet list, surge cards) with a different font pairing. Inline code stays IBM Plex Mono in every card. The big title slide H1 (Press Start 2P) is out of scope and unchanged. Meters are a rough guide: READ = legibility on a projector, MERGE = how seamless Latin sits inside Japanese, RETRO = how much JRPG flavor remains.
